review: compliance-dock full cycle 02 materials/UV anti-plastic critic
scope: Current rendered pixels only. Categories 4 and 6 independently; no previous reports, scores, production narrative, code, native scene or map inspected.

category_names.4: Tactile material identity and UV/texture discipline
category_names.6: Approved spawn colour coherence and restrained accents

threshold: Each assigned category must be strictly greater than 93.
verdict_detail: Both assigned categories pass narrowly. No material or colour visual veto and no critical defect is visible in this image set. This does not approve the other rubric categories or certify native/objective validation.

observations.finding: Cloth is matte and has broad drape, thickness and restrained weave. Plaster grain appears in the check-in close view; counter rail wear is localized. The close views resolve material detail that is deliberately quiet in wider views.
Painted blue steel is matte to semi-matte rather than glossy toy plastic. Bare rollers and small fittings have a narrower, brighter response. Large blue faces still share a somewhat uniform finish.

Glazing, dark rubber wheels and matte cloth remain visually different under neutral lighting. Chair upholstery is less tactile than the trolley cloth, and wood is confined to small warm counter accents.

The brightest blue is concentrated on the inspection assembly; it becomes a quieter deep blue in reverse and secondary views. Warm off-white/plaster, navy/charcoal, orange staff doors/signs, yellow route markings and drab cloth connect to the approved spawn palette while supporting the colder dock mood.

The coarse cloth checker is visible over the drape and rounded end without an obvious abrupt tear in this angle. The hanging face contains broad nearly uniform cells, so this view is weak evidence for small fold distortion or density consistency. No native UV continuity or numerical tolerance is claimed.

repairs.action: Add a finer cloth-specific checker view of the same consumed surface that includes the top-to-hanging-face transition and rounded end. Use the image to assess visible distortion; retain the matte broad-fold beauty treatment.

Give the largest painted-steel faces slightly more broad, sparse roughness variation and a few use-specific contact changes. Keep the existing localized wear; do not add uniform scratches or blanket dirt.
Separate the chair pads a little more clearly from the hard frame through a softer, darker upholstery response and restrained surface variation.
Strengthen the small wood accents with broad warm tonal variation on the stamp handle and board edge, without high-frequency grain or extra gloss.

pixel_limits: Rendered pixels cannot certify native UV topology, checker-node consumption, material graph wiring, numerical texel density, editable-source cleanliness or dependency portability.
No numerical UV tolerance is invented.
All 27 current beauty images, four approved spawn reference images and eight completed current diagnostic images were actually opened before this verdict.
